REASSEMBLY
NOTICE:
When using a vise, do not overtighten it.
1. COAT PARTS INDICATED BY ARROWS WITH MOLYBå
DENUM DISULFIDE LITHIUM BASE GREASE
(See page SR-9)
2. tNSTALL MAIN SHAFT ASSEMBLY
(a) Using a snap ring expander, install a new snap ring on the
lower side.
(b) Install the main shaft assembly.
(c) Using a snap ring expander, install a new snap ring on the
upper side.
3. INSTALL MAIN SHAFT BUSHING
{a) Coat a new bushing with molybdenum disulfide lithium
base grease.
{b) Using SST and a hammer, tap in the main shaft bushing.
SST 09608---04031
4. INSTALL BREAK AWAY BRACKET ANO TILT LEVER
(a) Install the No. 2 support collar to the break away bracket.
{b) Install the break away bracket, tilt lever lock boll, stopper
N FOa-196 and tilt lever.
HINT:
Align the holes in the column tube with the projections of the tilt
lever lock bolt and stopper.
(c) Install the adjusting nut by rotating ii counterctockwlse in
the specified torque so that the locking load (load applied
to when a knob is operated) of the tilt lever will be 38 - 82
N (3.9 - 8.4 kgf, 8.5 - 18.4 lbf).
Torque: 9 N,m - 14 N,m (90 kgf.cm - 145 kgf,cm, 80
in.-lbf-10 tt-lbf)
